system.notes:
Normal | Leader

A seasoned guard with a mace, a whistle, and a bellowing voice. Motives & Tactics: Arrest, close gates, pin down, seek glory

Difficulty: 14 | Thresholds: 7/13 | HP: 7 | Stress: 3

ATK: +4 | Weapon: Melee | 1d10+4 phy

Experience: Commander +2, Local Knowledge +2

Features

Rally Guards - Action: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight the Head Guard and up to 2d4 allies within Far range.

On My Signal - Reaction: Countdown (5). The first time the Head Guard is spotlighted, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC makes an attack roll. When it triggers, all Archer Guards within Far range make a standard attack with advantage against the nearest target within their range. If multiple attacks hit the same target, combine their damage.

Momentum - Reaction: When the Head Guard makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
